tool.name: Download NCBI taxonomy for eDNAFlow LCA
tool.description: install a versioned NCBI ranked-lineage taxonomy snapshot

param.name: name
param.label: Display name
param.help: Optional. By default the snapshot is named from its installation date and taxonomy checksum.

param.name: source_archive
param.label: Taxonomy archive
param.help: Optional development/testing input. If omitted, the official NCBI expanded taxonomy archive is downloaded.

tool.help:
Downloads the NCBI expanded taxonomy archive and installs ``rankedlineage.dmp`` for use by the eDNAFlow LCA Galaxy tool.
The installed snapshot ID combines the installation date and the first eight hexadecimal characters of the extracted taxonomy SHA-256. Identical content installed on the same day therefore has the same identifier; different content receives a different identifier.
The optional taxonomy archive input exists primarily to support deterministic testing. If omitted, the official NCBI expanded taxonomy archive is downloaded.
